title: Loose stitching
text: Loose stitching. The “kantha stitching is very loose and breaks easily.  I only used it on my bed for a week.  Aside from my dogs, whose paws snagged the loose stitching, just making the bed caused the stitching to break.  I donated it to charity within a month of purchase.  Pretty to look at but not practical.
